name: cols_ten287_rec_events
sql: select column_name, data_type from information_schema.columns where table_schema='ten287_rec' and table_name='events' order by ordinal_position

name: cols_ten287_rec_ticks
sql: select column_name, data_type from information_schema.columns where table_schema='ten287_rec' and table_name='ticks' order by ordinal_position

name: cols_ten287_bot_alerts
sql: select column_name, data_type from information_schema.columns where table_schema='ten287_bot' and table_name='alerts' order by ordinal_position

name: cols_public_kibl_fixtures
sql: select column_name, data_type from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='kibl_fixtures' order by ordinal_position

name: cols_ten280_bot_alerts
sql: select column_name, data_type from information_schema.columns where table_schema='ten280_bot' and table_name='alerts' order by ordinal_position

name: ticks_books_24h
sql: select book, count(*) n, count(distinct event_id) ev from ten287_rec.ticks where seen_at > now()-interval '24 hours' group by 1 order by 2 desc

name: skey_fns
sql: select n.nspname, p.proname, pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid) args from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname in ('ten280_bot','ten287_bot','ten287_rec') order by 1,2
